sections.title: Introduction and Goals
sections.content: Standardized blueprint for building modern, highly scalable systems with API orientation, SaaS multi-tenancy, and progressive evolution.
constraints: Progressive Evolution via incremental complexity (Canon of Progressive Evolution)
Polyglot architecture chosen by workload suitability via ADR
Strict Decoupling via ESLint boundary enforcement

sections.title: Mandatory Quality Attributes
constraints: Progressive Evolution: Zero-refactoring path to microservices via Dapr
SaaS Multi-Tenancy: Dual-Layer Isolation (Application Filters + Native DB Failsafe)
